meta.notes: Swatch colors sampled from official Olympic CDN swatch images (olympic.com/exterior-colors). Codes are for internal catalog maintenance only — not shown to customers.

colors.name: Cedar
colors.description: Classic warm cedar brown — one of the most popular fence stain colors for residential wood.

colors.name: Cedar Naturaltone
colors.description: Enhances natural wood grain with a warm cedar tint and lighter, semi-transparent coverage.

colors.name: Black Walnut
colors.description: Rich walnut tone that deepens wood character while letting grain show through.

colors.name: Coffee
colors.description: Medium coffee brown that adds warmth while keeping wood texture visible.

colors.name: Autumn Brown
colors.description: Warm earthy brown inspired by natural autumn wood tones.

colors.name: Cape Cod Gray
colors.description: Soft weathered gray with warm undertones — popular for contemporary and coastal homes.

colors.name: Deep Redwood
colors.description: Bold red-brown reminiscent of classic redwood fencing.
